chapterTitle: Chapter 11 Reactions of Alkyl Halides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
title: Problem 11-17

pages.text: PROBLEM 11-17 What stereochemistry do you expect for the alkene obtained by E2 elimination of (1R,2R)-1,2-dibromo-1,2-diphenylethane? Draw a Newman projection of the reacting conformation.
